name: @wrenyard/pet
description: Wrenyard desktop task visualizer/observer pixel construction-site pet

scripts.build:main: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && esbuild src/preloads/entity-preload.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/main/main/entity-preload.js --format=cjs --target=es2022 --platform=node --external:electron && esbuild src/preloads/graph-slip-preload.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/main/main/graph-slip-preload.js --format=cjs --target=es2022 --platform=node --external:electron && esbuild src/preloads/transcript-preload.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/main/main/transcript-preload.js --format=cjs --target=es2022 --platform=node --external:electron
scripts.build:renderer: esbuild src/overlay/house/index.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer/house.js --format=iife --target=es2022 && esbuild src/overlay/worker/index.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer/worker.js --format=iife --target=es2022 && esbuild src/overlay/taskgraph-entity/index.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer/entity.js --format=iife --target=es2022 && esbuild src/panels/stats/index.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer/stats.js --format=iife --target=es2022 && esbuild src/panels/settings/index.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer/settings.js --format=iife --target=es2022 && esbuild src/panels/transcript/index.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer/transcript.js --format=iife --target=es2022 && esbuild src/panels/observatory/index.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/renderer/graph-slip.js --format=iife --target=es2022 && node tools/copy-renderer-assets.mjs
scripts.build: pnpm run build:main && pnpm run build:renderer
scripts.test: pnpm run build:renderer && vitest run && node tools/renderer-cleanup-scan.mjs
